name: supply-chlorine-stopgap
narrative: Ngozi starts at the checks, where ClearWater Action's donated chlorine is ninety days past the date it was promised and the Sahel CHI store in Kano that refills the dispensers sits under its two-month floor. She opens the donation and reads it as ClearWater gave it: in kind, nothing to pay, 400 jerry cans still to arrive. Instead of chasing ClearWater again, she points an alert at their supply desk's email for the store falling below its minimum or their shipment passing its date, and checks it at once: both facts go to ClearWater straight from the record. For a stop-gap she has asked Harmattan Health Supplies for nationally registered chlorine. Their quote reads Aquaguard at 1.25%, 90 jerry cans within a week, and she files the product's registration certificate beside the quotation. Gidan Ruwa Traders' quote is cheaper, but she awards the stop-gap to Harmattan in her own name and writes down why. On the award, decided under her name with her reason, she asks the national regulator for its approval and records their approval, resting on the registration certificate she has just filed. Then she asks Northstar Fund, which pays for the programme, to approve the spend, and Place order greys out, naming the answer it is waiting for. Northstar says yes. Ngozi records their answer, Place order comes back, and she orders the jerry cans for the Kano store within a week; this time it goes through, with a price the donation never had. When the jerry cans reach Kano, Bala at the Sahel CHI store opens the store's own update link, with no labs login, finds the stop-gap order already on it, and records his goods received note himself, batch and expiry included, so the 90 cans enter the store's ledger in Sahel CHI's name. Last Ngozi reads the Kano store: its cover has risen, and the page says what it was before Bala's note, but it is still below its floor, and ClearWater's 400 jerry cans sit beside the balance, overdue and not counted as cover: the stop-gap bridges the gap, and ClearWater's cans are what will close it.

features.description: contract_delivery_overdue fires when signed_on plus promised_lead_time_days has passed and the contract is not fully received, carrying days_late, expected_on and the supplier.
features.verify: pytest connect_labs/supply_chain/tests -k contract_delivery_overdue asserts days_late and expected_on in the facts

features.description: shipment_overdue fires for a shipment whose expected_on has passed with no receipt and status not delivered or lost.
features.verify: Playwright: /supply/checks/ shows 'Shipment past its expected date' with 'days late' 90 for CWA-DON-2026-02/1

features.description: stock_below_minimum fires when a supply point's months of stock is under its own min_months_of_stock.
features.verify: Playwright: /supply/checks/ lists 'Below its own minimum' for the Sahel CHI Kano chlorine store with min months of stock 2
